Science project due in five minutes? Sol and the Narrator save it with five things: write your question at the top, say the one thing you changed and what you measured, say how many times you ran it, turn your numbers into a graph, and write down what went wrong. Ignite's free Scientific Research & Data Analysis course teaches how real research works, from collecting data to analyzing it.
Website: https://ignitefindyourfire.org/
Sign up: https://forms.ignitefindyourfire.org/t/oqB8WMKbJ6us
